classes.name: Folkeafstemning
classes.locator: https://stat.gl/publ/da/GF/2026/pdf/Gr%C3%B8nland%20i%20tal%202026.pdf ("I 1979 stemte Grønland om hjemmestyre, og i 2008 om selvstyre. I 1982 stemte Grønland for at forlade EU.")
classes.note: Greenland-wide votes on home rule (1979), leaving the European Community (1982) and self-government (2008). An independence agreement must be approved by a referendum in Greenland (Self-Government Act § 21), and the alcohol act allows local or national alcohol referendums. No Greenlandic referendum act exists. Danish realm referendums were held in Greenland in some years (the Folketing act for Greenland was amended for referendums in 1993) but not in 1992 (Maastricht, by a special act) or 2022 (defence opt-out, § 3 of lov nr. 578).
classes.disposition_reason: No official result for the 1979, 1982 or 2008 votes is online: valg.gl lists no referendum, Statbank has no referendum table, and the Statistical Yearbooks give only the years. The results sit in the Landsting/Inatsisartut records and the Danish government's announcements of each vote, which are not published as files.

classes.name: Valg til Europa-Parlamentet i Grønland
classes.locator: https://stat.gl/publ/da/GF/2026/pdf/Gr%C3%B8nland%20i%20tal%202026.pdf ("Danmark medlem af EU i 1973. Efter en folkeafstemning i 1982 ...")
classes.note: Greenland formed its own one-seat constituency within Denmark at the direct elections of 1979 and 1984 and left the Community on 1 February 1985.
classes.disposition_reason: No official source online gives Greenland's European Parliament votes: Statistics Denmark's results tables start after 1985 and its scanned 1979 and 1984 volumes were not found; neither valg.gl nor Statbank covers them.

classes.name: Grønlands Landsråd
classes.locator: https://inatsisartut.gl/media/elklpgit/d-inatsisartut-website-inatsisartutgl-media-10680-201109-brochure-etablering-af-landsraadet-for-100-aar-siden-a4-dk.pdf ("befolkningen den 29. juni 1951 for første gang fik mulighed for at stemme")
classes.note: One Landsråd for all Greenland, elected by men and women over 23 for four-year terms (1951-55 to 1975-79) in single-member constituencies; replaced by the Landsting under home rule on 1 May 1979.
classes.disposition_reason: No official results publication of the Landsråd elections is online; the votes would have to be taken from scanned Danish government reports or the Landsråd's printed proceedings, neither of which is published as a file.

classes.name: Bygdebestyrelsesvalg
classes.locator: https://nalunaarutit.gl/Groenlandsk-lovgivning/2016/L-27-2016 ("Der vælges fælles bygdebestyrelser. En fælles bygdebestyrelse skal omfatte mindst 2 bygder inden for samme kommune"; four-year term)
classes.note: Joint councils of 3 or 5 members for groups of settlements, elected in April of the municipal election year; each council decides the grouping and the number of members. 26 constituencies in 2009. Settlement councils existed before the 2009 reform, when several were merged.
classes.disposition_reason: No published results: valg.gl's election list has no settlement-council election, Statbank has no table, and the Statistical Yearbook gives only the date of the 2013 vote. Results are declared by each municipality's valgbestyrelse and not published centrally.
